newsitem.title: CHINA: Guangnan details US$100 mln bond issue.
newsitem.headline: Guangnan details US$100 mln bond issue.

text.p: Live and fresh food distributor Guangnan (Holdings) Ltd said on Monday it had issued US$100 million convertible guaranteed bonds due 2000.

Guangnan said the bonds would bear an interest rate of 1.75 percent per annum payable in arrears with a right to convert into the company's shares at a conversion price of HK$14.03 each between July 10, 1997 and June 30, 2000 subject to adjustment.
Guangnan shares gained HK$0.25 to HK$11.60 by noon on Monday.
Goldman Sachs (Asia) L.L.C. is the manager of the issue.
The Luxembourg stock exchange has granted the listing of the bonds, the company said.
The manager of the issue was also granted an option to subscribe up to a further US$10 million of the 1.75 percent bonds to cover overallotment, it said.
Guangnan said the bonds were being offered to institutional and professional investors in Hong Kong and to other investors outside Hong Kong.

Interest payment dates will be June 30 and December 31 commencing in December 1997. The bonds will be redeemed on June 30, 2000 at 113.15 percent of their principal amount together with interest, it said.
Last month, Guangnan said it would be required to issue 56 million new shares, or 6.3 percent of its enlarged share capital, on full conversion of the bonds into company shares.

Guangnan had said that the proceeds of the bond issue would be used to buy stakes in seven firms under prawn and pearl farming group Guangdong Anhua Pearl Industry Group Co Ltd, to build a warehouse in China, and to buy a stake in seasoning powders joint ventures.
Proceeds would also be used to expand supermarket outlets in Hong Kong and China, and for working capital, it said.
